question: The Sangeetha Kala Vibhushan award for 2020 was given to which of the following personalities?

options.text: Vannadil Pudiyaveettil Dhananjayan and Shanta Dhananjayan

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Vannadil Pudiyaveettil Dhananjayan and Shanta Dhananjayan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vannadil Pudiyaveettil Dhananjayan** and **Shanta Dhananjayan** are renowned **Bharatanatyam dancers** and choreographers.
 
• They are celebrated for their contribution to **Indian classical dance**, especially **Bharatanatyam**, as well as for their work in promoting and teaching the art form globally.
 
• The couple founded the **Bharatakalanjali**, a dance academy in **Chennai**, to train students in Bharatanatyam and other classical dance forms.
 
• Their performances are known for their **spiritual depth**, technical precision, and storytelling through dance.
 
• They have been recipients of numerous awards, including the prestigious **Padma Bhushan** for their contributions to Indian dance and culture.
 
• The **Sangeetha Kala Vibhushan** award in 2020 was bestowed upon them in recognition of their lifetime achievements and contributions to the field of classical dance.
 
• They have also collaborated with leading musicians and dancers to enrich the classical dance repertoire.
 
• Their work has inspired generations of dancers, both in India and abroad, making them iconic figures in the world of Indian classical arts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Priyadarshini Govind and Rajkumar Bharathi**__

 __
 
• **Priyadarshini Govind** is a renowned Bharatanatyam dancer known for her mastery in **abhinaya** (expression) and storytelling techniques.
 
• **Rajkumar Bharathi**, the great-grandson of **Subramania Bharati**, is a celebrated musician and composer specializing in **Carnatic music**.
 
• While they are prominent figures in the arts, they have not been recipients of the **Sangeetha Kala Vibhushan** award for 2020.
 
 
 
• **Yamini Krishnamurthy and Saroja Vaidyanathan**__
 __
 
• **Yamini Krishnamurthy** is a legendary Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi dancer, often referred to as the **torchbearer of Indian classical dance**.
 
• **Saroja Vaidyanathan** is a Padma Bhushan awardee and an acclaimed Bharatanatyam exponent who has contributed significantly to the propagation of classical dance.
 
• Despite their illustrious careers, they did not receive the **Sangeetha Kala Vibhushan** award in 2020.
 
 
 
• **Uma Sharma and Jatin Goswami**__
 
 
• **Uma Sharma** is a celebrated Kathak dancer known for reviving and promoting the **classical dance form** through performances and teaching.
 
• **Jatin Goswami** is an eminent Sattriya dancer and choreographer, contributing to the promotion of **Assamese dance traditions**.
 
• While their contributions to Indian dance are significant, they were not recipients of the **Sangeetha Kala Vibhushan** award in 2020.
